notes.title: Pixel Force – Developer Live Stream
notes.content:
[h1]Watch our live stream![/h1]
Join us at the Summer Game Festival as we're playing through the Pixel Force Demo and answering the Community questions live!

[h1]About the game[/h1]
This is a sandbox-style strategy game. In City A, you are playing a certain famous home console that was popular in the 1990s. By using different cassette effects, you fight the enemy and work towards saving humanity from the grasp of an evil AI.

[h1]Join the Community[/h1]
